intertangle.definition: v. t. To entangle; to intertwine.

intertangled.translation: 使纠缠( intertangle的过去式和过去分词 )

intertangles.translation: 使纠缠（intertangle的第三人称单数形式）

intertangling.translation: 使纠缠( intertangle的现在分词 )

intertarsal.definition:
a. Between the tarsal bones; as, the intertarsal
   articulations.

intertestamental.translation: a. 写于(或属于)基督教《圣经》新约与旧约之间的

intertexts.translation: (intertext 的复数) abbr. Internet text 因特网文本

intertexture.definition:
n. The act of interweaving, or the state of being
   interwoven; that which is interwoven.
intertexture.translation: n. 交织, 编织, 交织物

intertidal.definition: a. of or relating to the littoral area above the low-tide mark
intertidal.translation: a. 高潮线与低潮线之间的

intertie.definition:
n. In any framed work, a horizontal tie other than sill and
   plate or other principal ties, securing uprights to one another.

intertonguing.translation: 交错沉积; 交错相变化

intertransverse.definition: a. Between the transverse processes of the vertebrae.

intertrigo.definition: n chafing between two skin surfaces that are in contact (as in the armpit or under the breasts or between the thighs)

intertrochanteric.definition: a. Between the trochanters of the femur.

intertropica stomatitis.translation: [医] 热带性口炎, 口炎性腹泻

intertropical.definition: a. Situated between or within the tropics.
intertropical.translation: a. 南北回归线之间的, 热带地方的

intertropics.translation: 北回归线与南回归线之间的地带里的任一地区

intertubular.definition:
a. Between tubes or tubules; as, intertubular cells;

intertubular substance.translation: [医] 小管间物质, 牙质
